summary: Separate exact same-line RFI roles and Submittal statuses from their workflow identifiers across supported local content.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
Offline reproductions lose same-line workflow metadata and absorb compact filename suffixes into identifiers
Existing exact identifier normalization and role/status allowlists define a conservative reusable boundary
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only an existing allowlisted role or status immediately following an exact identifier is separated.
Free-form descriptions and unknown provider-specific status labels remain unchanged and require review.
The change does not infer approval authority, precedence or relationships between documents.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer document, external provider or paid model is used.
